name: tier-router
description: Model routing that actually routes: a Claude Code mod that sets the model of every main-loop request and every subagent spawn to the lowest tier that does the job, lifts for deep and security work, and never takes a switch whose prompt-cache rewrite costs more than it saves.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: full: route the main loop and subagents. subagents: route spawns only. advise: dry run, show what it would do. off.

mainFloor.title: Main-loop floor
mainFloor.description: The lowest model the main loop may drop to for lookups and quick questions.

lift.title: Lift to Opus
lift.description: When the session runs below Opus, which turns are lifted to Opus on their own: security only, every deep turn, or none (a one-line suggestion instead).

maxSwitchTokens.title: Max cache rewrite per switch
maxSwitchTokens.description: A down-switch that would force more than this many tokens to be re-cached on the cheaper model is skipped.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long a model's prompt cache is assumed to stay warm.

routeCustomAgents.title: Route custom agents
routeCustomAgents.description: Also send your own and plugin agents (not just built-ins) to a cheaper model when they were spawned without one. Deep agent types (security, architect, plan) are never sent down.
